data.body:
Targeted completion evidence for the five bounded-search gaps at merged commit c87afedba88b14c5fd43e1540d845787014632ed (Gerrit 1553, LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, zero unresolved comments; CI 15/15 jobs; focused completion suite 140 passed):

1. Unresolvable --only/--except tokens: src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/reconcile_helpers.py::resolve_selection resolves every token against current local ids or BindingStore Jira keys and raises SelectionError listing all unresolved tokens. tests/interfaces/facades/test_bridge_selection_heldout.py::test_partial_unresolved_selection_is_atomic_and_never_acquires_lock and ::test_real_cli_and_engine_report_semantic_selection_failure prove exit 2, both missing names, no lock, and the installed CLI child-process boundary. tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/orchestrate/test_bridge_request_heldout.py::test_unresolved_selection_names_every_identifier_before_lock independently pins the engine route.

2. Selection disappearance race: reconcile_helpers.py::ensure_selection_current computes missing preflight ids after the locked local load and raises SelectionStaleError naming each missing id. src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/__main__.py::_reconcile_exception_result maps SelectionStaleError to INVALID_INVOCATION, whose canonical exit is 2. tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/orchestrate/test_bridge_selection_scope_heldout.py::test_disappeared_preflight_selection_stops_before_differ_or_apply uses id vanished, requires that name in the exception, and proves differ/apply/persist never run.

3. External-DC continuity: tests/external/live_jira_dc/_dc_support.py::run_reconcile remains present and builds python -m rebar_reconciler --mode <legacy-mode> --repo-root, preserving only and the compatibility path. Existing consumers remain at _dc_fixtures.py, test_dc_mutations.py, and test_store_copy_isolation.py. The additive run_bridge helper is separate; no existing run_reconcile consumer was removed.

4. ADR convention and links: docs/adr/0092-bridge-primary-vocabulary-compatibility-adapters.md is reserved by docs/adr/.numbers/0092, indexed in generated docs/adr/README.md, and linked from docs/architecture.md and docs/release-notes.md. Verified +1 ran scripts/check_adr_numbers.py and scripts/gen_adr_index.py --check on this exact merge.

5. Interface/environment continuity: tests/interfaces/facades/test_bridge_cli_heldout.py proves canonical and legacy CLI behavior; tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/orchestrate/test_bridge_request_heldout.py proves direct-engine defaults; tests/interfaces/facades/test_library.py and test_mcp.py prove library and MCP reconcile compatibility; tests/unit/workflow/test_bridge_primary_workflow_heldout.py plus test_reconcile_workflow_lint.py prove current/rollback workflow and exit mappings; the external-DC witnesses above prove the retained helper. The prior [operator-attested] c11 evidence covers older checked-out workflows and environments outside the repository snapshot.
